name: coordination-hooks
description: Project-orientation and coordination reminders, a Git-Controller mistake-prevention gate, an async Codex context-status reporter, and a synchronous peer-inbox consumer.

interface.shortDescription: Reviewable hooks for coordinated Codex sessions.
interface.longDescription: Adds project-orientation, unread-message, and role-binding reminders; a Git-Controller mistake-prevention gate; context_status_reporter.py, a stock-Codex async Stop hook that reads the current transcript and reports only fresh post-compaction native context measurements; and inbox_consumer.py (CDX-06), a SYNCHRONOUS Stop hook that checks the session's peer inbox for anything already queued and, if so, forces the turn to continue (Codex decision:block) with a fixed nudge -- plus report_inbox_consumption, an honesty attestation recorded on every check regardless of outcome, so a session that has not actually consumed its inbox can never be mistaken for one that has. Deployment-specific guidance stays in the project's native AGENTS.md instructions, and hook revocation remains an explicit operator action in Codex's supported /hooks surface.
defaultPrompt: Explain the installed coordination hook contract.
